title: Asana hook signature output, lookalike headers and non-values
summary: An X-Hook-Signature HMAC output, an X-Hook-Secret-Id header carrying an identifier, and placeholders, environment references and masked displays under X-Hook-Secret.
rationale: X-Hook-Signature is the HMAC computed with the shared secret, so it is derived output that does not reveal the secret, and X-Hook-Secret-Id is a different header. Placeholders, references and masked text carry no value. Treating the signature as the secret would redact a value receivers compare in the clear.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#232). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy. Asana documents the signature as a SHA-256 HMAC over the delivery body computed with the shared secret; that it is not itself the secret, and that a placeholder or reference is not a value, are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: used afterwards to compute the SHA-256 HMAC signature (X-Hook-Signature) over webhook delivery bodies

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy.
